summary: Russian forces have advanced near Malikh Prokhodiv and Kalenykiv according to DeepStateUA. Ukrainian forces are facing challenges with personnel rotation in the 108th TR units. Russian forces are reportedly preparing to receive 30,000 troops from North Korea in the Voronezh region.
key_points: Russian forces have advanced near Malikh Prokhodiv and Kalenykiv (Source: @DeepStateUA/23683).
Russia is reportedly preparing to receive 30,000 troops from North Korea in the Voronezh region (Source: @UkraineNow/82928).
North Korea is reportedly preparing to transfer new ballistic missile launch systems to Russia (Source: @UkraineNow/82928).
Ukrainian forces conducted an attack on tourist bases in the Zaporozhye region, specifically Kirillovka, resulting in eight deaths (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31919).
Russian forces launched a group strike on a facility in the suburbs of Kyiv involving drones (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31909).
A Russian vessel was attacked twice, resulting in a fire on a ship carrying 2,800 tons of corn (Source: @UkraineNow/82927).
Russian forces are conducting infantry battles in several locations in the Sumy district including Mogritsa and Maryino (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31909).
The 126th Motorized Rifle Regiment of the 71st Guards Motorized Rifle Division liberated the village of Zakharovka (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31909).

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces have achieved tactical advances near Malikh Prokhodiv and Kalenykiv. Significant geopolitical developments include reports of North Korean troops and ballistic missile technology moving toward Russia. Ongoing strikes continue to impact civilian infrastructure and maritime logistics in the Black Sea.

points: Ukrainian forces conducted strikes on tourist bases in the Kirillovka area of the Zaporozhye region, resulting in eight deaths including two children (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31919).
A merchant vessel flying the Palau flag carrying 2,800 tons of corn was attacked twice by Russia, causing a fire (Source: @UkraineNow/82927).
The 108th TR Brigade reports significant personnel issues due to a lack of rotation for over six months (Source: @UkraineNow/82931).
Ukrainian naval drones recently attacked four tankers near Novorossiysk, including one chartered by Chevron (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31908).
Russia is reportedly preparing to receive 30,000 troops from North Korea in the Voronezh region (Source: @UkraineNow/82928).
North Korea is reportedly preparing to transfer new ballistic missile launch systems to Russia (Source: @UkraineNow/82928).
Russian forces are conducting infantry battles in the Sumy district, including Mogritsa, Maryino, and Novaya Sech (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31909).
The 126th Motorized Rifle Regiment of the 71st Guards Motorized Rifle Division liberated Zakharovka in the Volchansky district (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31909).
Russian forces have advanced near Malikh Prokhodiv and Kalenykiv (Source: @DeepStateUA/23683).
Fighting continues in the western part of Kupyansk south of the Oskol River (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31909).
Active fighting is occurring near the village of Nikolaypolye on the Konstantinovskiy front (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31909).
Russian forces have captured strongholds west of Aleksandrovka and advanced toward Zelenoye (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31909).
The 34th Guards Mountain Motorized Rifle Brigade and 11th Tank Battalion liberated Ivashkino (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31909).
Infantry battles continue in the Shostkinsky district of the Sumy region, including Ulanovo and Malaya Slobodka (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31909).
Ukrainian forces are conducting counterattacks near Stepnogorsk in the Zaporozhye region (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31909).
Energodar has been subjected to another massive attack (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31909).
Russian forces are conducting strikes in the Kherson region, including Aleshki and Radensk (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31909).
Russian tactical aviation activity has been reported on the southern direction (Source: @kpszsu/70074).
A group of reactive UAVs was reported over Zaporozhye heading west (Source: @kpszsu/70126).
Russian forces launched FAB strikes toward Kharkiv and Donetsk (Source: @eRadarrua/102716).
Five UAVs were spotted over the Black Sea, with two heading toward Vilkove (Source: @eRadarrua/102651).

sections.threat_assessment: The operational situation is characterized by Russian territorial advances in the eastern sectors and the potential influx of North Korean personnel and missile technology. The use of UAVs against civilian infrastructure and maritime vessels remains a high-frequency threat. The reported lack of rotation in Ukrainian TR units may impact long-term defensive capabilities.
sections.regional_response: The Polish Senate has passed a resolution protesting anti-Ukrainian sentiment and xenophobia (Source: @UkraineNow/82918). The US administration has warned Ukraine against attacking non-Russian vessels (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31908).
sections.intelligence_notes: The involvement of North Korean assets, including troops and ballistic missile systems, represents a significant escalation in the conflict's scope. The use of fraudulent QR codes in occupied Crimea to fund Ukrainian FPV units highlights ongoing asymmetric financial warfare (Source: @UkraineNow/82917).
